reviewVerdict.summary: Independent review of f0e0f06 rejects the claimed P0/P1 close-out. Default Claim still stamps HEAD (bypassing fork-point), journal PREPARED recovery can roll back a successful two-file commit, baseline integrity is not fail-closed, mailbox path CAS tests are incomplete, and DualAgentLoop still calls obsolete gh copilot.

issues.problem: P0 baseline fork-point guard is incomplete. Claim only checks merge-base fork-point when -Baseline is explicitly passed. The default path calls Get-VcsBaselineRevision, which returns git rev-parse HEAD, then stamps owner.baseline to that HEAD (or magic '0'). On a feature branch this is exactly the forbidden 'move baseline past fork-point to shrink review scope' attack. BindSession still has no fork-point check at all.
issues.fixSuggestion: Make Claim/BindSession default baseline the merge-base with origin/main|origin/master|main|master (fail closed if unresolved). Reject auto-detected HEAD when it is a strict descendant of the fork-point. Apply the same ancestor+fork-point checks to BindSession. Add a negative test that Claim without -Baseline on a feature branch cannot record HEAD.

issues.problem: Two-phase journal recovery is not crash-atomic. PREPARED with any missing tmpPath is treated as rollback. After both File.Move calls succeed and before journal state=COMMITTED, a crash leaves PREPARED + no tmps, so recovery restores backups and silently undoes a successful commit. Recovery catch { Write-Warning } also fail-opens on corrupt journals. Tests only cover the tmp-still-present roll-forward case.
issues.fixSuggestion: On PREPARED always roll-forward remaining tmp files; missing tmps mean moves already applied (no-op), never rollback a PREPARED journal just because tmps are gone. Rollback only when state is ROLLED_BACK or prepare failed before journal write. Throw (fail closed) on unreadable/corrupt journals. Add a crash-after-both-moves negative test that recovered files keep the new content.

issues.problem: Assert-FeatureBaselineIntegrity is not fail-closed: empty authoritative baseline returns. Get-AuthoritativeFeatureBaseline swallows non-mutation JSON parse errors on mirrors/feature-state/00_workflow_state. Validate-TestCoverageState calls Get-AuthoritativeFeatureBaseline -SpecDirectory, but the function parameter is SpecDir, so the non-VCS evidence path throws a parameter-binding error instead of validating digest. Get-SemanticRiskAssessment still sets svnRev=$null when svn info fails and continues, unlike Get-ChangeSetDigest which throws SVN_INFO_FAILED.
issues.fixSuggestion: Throw BASELINE_MISSING when authoritative baseline is empty during integrity checks. Re-throw parse/IO errors instead of swallowing. Fix the -SpecDir named argument. Fail closed in Get-SemanticRiskAssessment when svn info/diff exits non-zero.

issues.problem: Path-traversal defense only rejects illegal characters in FeatureName. -MailboxPath and -SpecDirectory still resolve '..' via GetFullPath and can write the mailbox outside the workspace. Claimed CAS-conflict negative tests are absent; review-mailbox.tests.ps1 never asserts MAILBOX_CAS_CONFLICT for wrong ExpectedRound/ExpectedSubmittedAt.
issues.fixSuggestion: After GetFullPath, require mailbox/spec paths to stay under the physical workspace root (Resolve-PhysicalPathIdentity). Add negative tests for ../ MailboxPath and CAS mismatches.

issues.problem: Claimed Copilot invocation fix is still the obsolete 'gh copilot suggest/explain' CLI, which cannot drive Copilot coding review or return the required JSON verdict. Reviewer JSON parse failures throw PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. Test-gate self-heal 'continue' has no round cap, so failing tests loop forever without consuming MaxRounds.
issues.fixSuggestion: Invoke the current Copilot CLI (copilot) with a non-interactive prompt, fail closed on non-JSON output, and bound self-heal retries by MaxRounds (or a dedicated verify-attempt limit).

reviewVerdict.nextPromptForDev: Do not claim P0/P1 closure yet. (1) Default Claim/BindSession baseline must be the trunk fork-point, not HEAD; cover BindSession. (2) PREPARED journal with missing tmps must roll-forward, not rollback; fail closed on corrupt journals; add crash-after-move test. (3) Assert-FeatureBaselineIntegrity must throw on empty/corrupt baseline; fix Get-AuthoritativeFeatureBaseline -SpecDir; SVN semantic risk must fail closed. (4) Confine MailboxPath/SpecDir to workspace; add CAS negative tests. (5) Replace gh copilot suggest/explain with current Copilot CLI and cap self-heal retries. Re-run pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/run-all-tests.ps1 to 100% PASS before next DevSubmit.
